rationale: With only 21 minutes to close, SENS has already collapsed from a $13.98 high to $10.06, sitting at just 7.2% of its intraday range and well below VWAP ($12.03) and the 9-EMA ($10.25), indicating sustained selling pressure throughout the session. The spread is wide at ~60 bps, the stock is highly volatile (ATR $0.15 on 5m bars against a $10 price), and the last-minute forced liquidation risk on a name this erratic makes risk/reward unfavorable in either direction with insufficient time to develop a clean thesis.
